item.summary: fix(test): gateway publication suite fails Windows teardown with EBUSY (#127201) The harness removed its fixture root while a per-agent SQLite handle opened under it was still cached, so the transcript-report restart case failed in teardown on Windows instead of in an assertion. Closing the agent cache after the shared state database only moves the lock, because the agent close releases leases through shared state and reopens it. Ordering the two closes the way the zalo and zalouser fixtures already do releases every handle before the removal, with no retry budget needed.
